stage1.title: VIDEO 1 — THE WORLD REVEAL
stage1.revealSubtitle: A new adventure is about to begin.
stage1.prompt:
Create a breathtaking cinematic announcement teaser for a brand-new original mobile game called MONSTER RUSH: THE LOST ISLAND.

STORYBOARD:

0–4 seconds:
Start in complete darkness. A tiny magical blue light appears. The camera emerges through enormous clouds, revealing a spectacular world of floating islands, waterfalls and ancient ruins.

4–8 seconds:
Fly dramatically through the magical environment. Reveal glowing crystals, mysterious bridges, waterfalls falling into the clouds and an enormous ancient portal in the distance.

8–12 seconds:
The camera approaches the portal. Magical energy begins to awaken the island. Golden particles and blue energy illuminate the environment.

12–15 seconds:
A spectacular wide shot reveals the entire lost island. A mysterious small creature silhouette appears on a cliff, looking toward the glowing portal.

VISUAL STYLE:
Premium stylized 3D animated fantasy game.
Exceptional environmental detail.
Beautiful cinematic lighting.
Rich turquoise, emerald green, gold and deep blue colors.
Epic scale, magical atmosphere and smooth camera movement.

AUDIO:
Epic orchestral fantasy music, deep cinematic impact and magical sparkling sound effects.

No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

stage2.title: VIDEO 2 — MEET THE HERO
stage2.revealSubtitle: An original character. A magical world. Endless possibilities.
stage2.prompt:
Create a spectacular animated character and world reveal for MONSTER RUSH: THE LOST ISLAND.

Use the supplied character and environment images as strict visual references.

The main character is an adorable turquoise-blue fantasy monster with large expressive amber eyes, tiny golden horns, a soft rounded body and glowing markings.

Preserve its exact appearance, proportions and distinctive details.

STORYBOARD:

0–4 seconds:
The camera travels through a beautiful floating island environment. A magical glowing crystal floats in the air. The camera turns toward a mysterious movement behind a rock.

4–7 seconds:
Our adorable turquoise monster hero suddenly jumps into the scene. The character lands, looks directly at the camera and smiles.

7–11 seconds:
The monster runs through the environment. Golden coins spin in the air. Glowing blue energy gems appear. The monster jumps and collects a crystal, creating a beautiful magical energy burst.

11–15 seconds:
The monster reaches an ancient treasure chest. The chest opens and releases spectacular golden light. The camera circles the character as the island lights up.

VISUAL STYLE:
Premium stylized 3D mobile game animation.
High-end character animation.
Beautiful materials and textures.
Rich environmental detail.
Smooth cinematic camera movement.
Vibrant colors and magical particles.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY IS CRITICAL.
Do not redesign the character.
Do not distort its face or proportions.

AUDIO:
Playful orchestral adventure music, cute character sound effects, magical crystal collection sounds and a satisfying treasure reveal.

No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

stage3.title: VIDEO 3 — OFFICIAL GAME LAUNCH TRAILER
stage3.revealSubtitle: From an idea to a playable experience.
stage3.prompt:
Create a premium, high-impact cinematic launch trailer for an original mobile game:

MONSTER RUSH: THE LOST ISLAND.

This should feel like the official launch trailer of a successful global mobile gaming franchise.

Use the uploaded character and environment images as strict visual references. Preserve the character's exact appearance throughout the entire video.

STORYBOARD:

0–3 seconds — THE HOOK:
A dramatic aerial camera shot reveals an enormous magical floating island. A powerful magical portal suddenly activates. The camera rapidly dives toward the island.

3–6 seconds — THE HERO:
Reveal our adorable turquoise monster hero. The character looks determined and ready for adventure. The camera moves close to its expressive face.

6–10 seconds — THE ACTION:
The monster runs through a magical environment. It jumps across floating platforms, collects glowing gems and golden coins, and narrowly avoids a huge rolling stone obstacle.

10–13 seconds — THE BIG MOMENT:
The monster jumps toward a massive glowing energy crystal. The crystal explodes into beautiful magical light. The entire island begins to glow.

13–15 seconds — THE FINAL REVEAL:
A spectacular cinematic pullback shows the monster standing heroically in front of the restored magical portal.

VISUAL DIRECTION:
Premium stylized 3D mobile game.
Exceptional visual polish.
Beautiful cinematic lighting.
Rich colors and high-quality materials.
Dynamic camera movement.
Fluid character animation.
Spectacular magical visual effects.

AUDIO:
Epic energetic orchestral game trailer music, powerful cinematic impacts, exciting movement and collection sound effects, memorable final musical hit.

No text, titles, subtitles, logos or watermarks.
